summary: No completed independent double-human review or calibrated semantic judge exists; tooling work must not be reported as quality validation.
resolution_condition: Complete G5 with real independent reviewers and publish only sanitized verified evidence.

summary: The first packet test failed because app.evaluation.quality_review did not exist.
resolution: Implemented strict packet publication and verification.

summary: Raw CRLF source bytes and LF-normalized reviewer text produced different SHA-256 values.
resolution: Bound source_artifact_sha256 and content_sha256 separately.

summary: The shared str_strip_whitespace model changed evidence content before hash validation.
resolution: QualityEvidence now forbids extra fields without mutating content whitespace.

summary: One pytest command used a duplicated agent/agent work directory and did not start.
resolution: Corrected the workspace path; the intended test then passed.

summary: Unsupported PowerShell RNG Fill call continued and wrote an all-zero 32-byte blinding key; generated v1 IDs were predictable.
resolution: Quarantined the v1 artifacts, regenerated v2 with RNG.Create().GetBytes, and added weak-key rejection.

summary: validate_quality_judgements was accidentally placed after the quality_review __all__ list, causing IndentationError during collection.
resolution: Moved the export name inside __all__; focused and broader evaluation tests passed.

summary: Grading only returned documents could hide relevant documents missed by retrieval and overstate nDCG.
resolution: Added explicit candidate pools, miss-aware recall@5 and nDCG, required pooled_variants for held-out decisions, superseded v2, and generated verified v3.

summary: A predictable or all-zero reviewer identity salt would make pseudonymous reviewer hashes guessable.
resolution: Submission validation rejects obviously weak salts; RED/GREEN CLI coverage uses an all-zero rejection case and a deterministic strong-salt acceptance case.

summary: PowerShell Get-Content without explicit UTF-8 displayed valid Chinese reviewer content as mojibake.
resolution: Verified stored Unicode through Python UTF-8 parsing and Get-Content -Encoding utf8; no hash-bound artifact was rewritten.

summary: Packets allowed 40 pooled candidates while reviewer judgements allowed only 20 labels.
resolution: Bound both fields to one 40-candidate constant and added a 21-candidate submission regression.

summary: A caller could self-declare pooled_variants without proving multiple retrieval runs.
resolution: Pooled items now bind at least two sorted unique run-manifest hashes including the evaluated source run; held-out creation rejects non-pooled items.

summary: One source_id could carry different content across returned, candidate, and reference evidence.
resolution: QualityReviewItem rejects cross-list evidence objects that disagree for the same source ID.

summary: The same reviewer could use different salts to obtain distinct hashes.
resolution: One campaign pepper now defines a shared identity domain and HMAC pseudonyms; aggregation rejects mixed domains.

summary: One uncertain candidate removed an entire query from precision, recall, and nDCG.
resolution: Uncertain returned grades score as 0 and uncertain pool grades as 2, retaining a conservative query-level bound.

summary: One pooled kappa mixed ordinal relevance, semantic labels, overall verdicts, and failure stages and could be dominated by candidate count.
resolution: Agreement is dimension-macro; Cohen's kappa is overall-answer only; retrieval uses separately gated weighted kappa.

summary: Approximately balanced stratified samples had no bound inclusion weights but could be used for held-out population claims.
resolution: Held-out acceptance requires all_cases until weighted sampling provenance exists.

summary: A control-map failure after packet publication left an orphan packet that blocked retry.
resolution: Retries verify exact packet/source/spec identity and publish only the missing control; exact controls are idempotent and mismatches fail closed.

summary: Judge stability compared every trial only with trial zero and judge kappa mixed heterogeneous labels.
resolution: Stability now covers all unordered trial pairs; judge raw agreement is dimension-macro and kappa is overall-answer only.

summary: Expected response mode and reference material can anchor refusal judgements.
resolution: Retained for criterion-based grading but explicitly classified as model/verdict-blinded reference-guided review, not verdict-blind evidence.

summary: The project virtual environment does not contain Ruff, so the requested extra lint probe could not run.
resolution: No lint claim is made; compileall, pip check, diff check, packet verification, public audit, focused tests, evaluation tests, and full pytest were executed.
